To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CSR has a positive impact on the performance of SMEs.

(i) the CSR activities of SMEs have a positive impact on their performance, (ii) the impact of the CSR activities on SMEs' performance is stronger when the SMEs are involved in more than one CSR activity, and (iii) the positive impact on performance of the CSR activities of the SMEs is stronger in the case of SMEs that have been in the market for a longer period of time.

the relationship between social responsibility and performance of SMEs.
the relationship between corporate social responsibility and firm performance.
the relationship between CSR practices and firm performance, in a developing context.
